visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a grey sweatshirt stands in a white-tiled bathroom. He looks around nervously with a darting gaze and then begins to pull his sweatshirt over his head, revealing a black undershirt. (2) A woman with short dark hair in a pink sweatshirt is scratching her scalp vigorously with both hands. White flakes of dandruff fall visibly onto her shoulders and the floor. (3) A man in a blue Balenciaga hoodie sits on a blue sofa. He watches something off-camera with a look of pure disgust, squinting his eyes and curling his lip, before suddenly smiling brightly at the camera. (4) A woman with long dark hair is in a bathroom, holding a pink cup. She brushes her teeth with extreme intensity, her face contorted in a gagging expression as foam appears around her mouth. (5) A man lies in a bed with grey sheets. He reaches under the blanket and pulls out a white hairdryer, turning it on and pointing it towards his body beneath the covers. (6) A woman with brown hair and bangs sits on a couch. She holds up a polaroid photo and a small pink mirror, posing with a focused expression as if taking a macro photo of a skin blemish. (7) A woman in a blue top sits on a blue sofa with a glass of water on a table. She meticulously sorts through stacks of 1000-dollar bills and pours a handful of coins into a glass, organizing them with precision. (8) A man in a light blue suit and a woman in a striped shirt stand in an office. The man sneezes violently, grabbing the woman for support, which results in an awkward and comical physical tangle as they both fall toward a desk.
